result.title: TAED: Trajectory-Aligned Encoder--Decoder Distillation for Detection Transformers
result.summary: Distilling localization knowledge into compact detection transformers (DETRs) requires consistent teacher-student query correspondence across decoder layers. However, in DETRs with encoder-based query selection, the teacher and student select top-K proposals independently. Same-rank queries can originate from different spatial locations and correspond to different objects, making rank-based layer-wise supervision unreliable. To address this problem, we propose Trajectory-Aligned Encoder-Decoder Distillation (TAED), a framework for knowledge transfer between DETRs of different capacities. Encoder feature distillation matches normalized multi-scale features to strengthen student representations and increase the number of teacher-student query pairs from the same encoder locations. Source-indexed query alignment pairs native queries from the same encoder locations and retains pairs associated with the same object for which the teacher provides reliable and more accurate final localization than the student. Trajectory-aligned localization distillation maintains these correspondences and uses teacher proposals and corresponding decoder-layer box predictions to guide student refinement, without introducing additional queries. On COCO, TAED improves DINO-R18 and two-stage Deformable DETR-R18 by 2.5 and 1.7 AP, respectively. Further gains on D-FINE and ECDet demonstrate applicability to recent real-time DETRs at no additional inference cost.

AI.brief_summary: 针对 DETR 类检测器蒸馏中师生独立选择 top-K 查询导致同名次查询空间与目标不一致的问题，提出 TAED：用编码器多尺度特征蒸馏增加同源查询对，并以源索引对齐查询、沿解码层保持轨迹对应做定位蒸馏，在 COCO 小模型上取得提升且不增加推理成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按来源对齐、跨解码层保持对应」的轨迹式监督可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的训练监督与贡献分配提供可供核查的线索，但检测查询对齐能否迁移到推理状态尚需判断。
